blocks.html: Vents for horizontal stack offsets required by Section 711.2 shall not be required where the stack and its offset are one pipe size larger than required for a building drain (see Table 710.1(1), Column 5) and the entire stack and offset are not less in cross- sectional area than that required for a straight stack plus the area of an offset vent as provided for in Section 907.
